checks.detail: No direct external positive/return short in reviewed endpoint graph.
Every master row has endpoints on its same exported endpoint-map net. Full native netlist/ERC remain separate root checks.

advisories.observation: Pin directions are correct, but A02 source lists ETA only and A03 REGEN only; neither independently establishes GX11 A2/A1 polarity.
advisories.suggested_correction: Append GX11 Rev6 10/23/15 p3-4 / CONTACTOR_OFFICIAL_WEB_RETRIEVAL.json to both source cells; retain ETA/REGEN endpoint sources.

advisories.observation: Both signal labels say AUX_NO, but endpoint map assigns distinct W033 and W034. This is not an electrical short.
advisories.suggested_correction: Optionally label AUX_SENSE and AUX_REFERENCE; do not infer physical monitor pinout or a certified mirror contact.

advisories.observation: STOP_MONITOR remains logical UNBOUND. GX11 auxiliary published minimum is 5 V and 0.1 mA; direct 3.3 V dry-contact sensing is not established.
advisories.suggested_correction: Before implementation bind a minimum 5 V wetting/sensing interface with >=0.1 mA within max auxiliary rating and input level adaptation; validate detection faults. No manufacturing credit now.

advisories.observation: RBF pull-up, series resistor, covered/bonded FPP and switch part are stated requirements rather than instantiated component circuits.
advisories.suggested_correction: Keep UNBOUND and build_approved=false until resistor/switch/grounding and actual FPP connector schema exist. Do not interpret these two logical rows as a finished inhibit circuit.

scope_limits: No power-on, charge, motion, contactor dropout, regen pulse or connector-resistance tests performed.
No manufacturing release, flight qualification, functional safety, battery balance or thermal closure inferred from this endpoint review.
Native schematic connectivity/ERC is not independently parsed here; exported endpoint map is checked, root performs native checks.
PV parallel current sharing, individual string blocking and out-of-range cold Voc remain parameterized requirements, not manufactured array evidence.
